prompts.idle:
Use case: precise-object-edit / coherent pixel sprite animation.
Asset: TTUNGT Ttungttang dog's corrected idle animation sheet for a MapleStory-style pet-house game.
Input 1 is the approved Ttungttang character design, preserve its identity, markings, compact body, huge fluffy curled tail, white muzzle/forehead/chest/paws, charcoal gray merle patches, tan cheek/eyebrow patches and blue eyes. Input 2 Guri is the mandatory pixel STYLE reference: similarly chunky native pixel clusters, limited flat cel shades, hard edges; no airbrush, gradients, anti-aliased painting, or detailed realistic fur. Do not turn dog into human/Guri.
Create exactly 12 sequential idle frames in an evenly spaced 4 columns by 3 rows sprite sheet, row-major chronological. Fully transparent background; NO labels/numbers/text, shadows/background props. Each frame equal-size cell with ample transparent gutter; the dog is the exact same size, same head center, same paw baseline, same viewing angle in every frame. Whole dog, ears and tail visible with no clipping.
Three-quarter front view facing viewer-left like reference. Retain cheerful little open smile and pink tongue. Correct BOTH icy blue eyes: compact consistent round black pupil inside blue iris, one tiny clean white highlight, same gaze. Viewer-left eye is narrower due perspective but NOT an elongated black blob, double pupil, cross-eye or disjoint dark mark. Eye geometry must stay fixed through all open-eye frames.
Animation has tiny smooth breathing and gentle ear/tail movement ONLY, no walking, no pose changes or head turns. Frames 1-8 almost identical gradual one-pixel breathing cycle. Frame9 eyes half close, frame10 fully close, frame11 half open, frame12 fully open matching frame1. Body proportions, outline, coat pattern and palette never drift or fluctuate. Intermediate frames must be actual in-between drawings. Keep light/color identical across entire sheet. Dog should read as about 38x36 native logical pixels, enlarged nearest-neighbor on sheet (Guri-like simple pixel art), not 64-pixel dense painting.

Preserve dog's corrected eyes (compact black pupil inside icy-blue iris), compact fluffy four-legged Pomeranian, white forehead blaze/muzzle/chest/paws, charcoal gray merle patches, tan cheeks/eyebrows and curled fluffy tail. Match EXACT same chunky pixel scale, limited flat cel palette, dark crisp one-native-pixel outline, no gradients, realistic fur, soft painting, lighting changes.
Output exactly12 actual consecutive animation drawings arranged4columns by3rows, chronological row-major. Transparent background, evenly spaced equal cells, same dog scale and fixed paw baseline and head/body landmarks across frames. Full ears and tail, generous transparent cell gutters so adjacent sprites never touch. NO labels, text, annotations, props except specified. Three-quarter front view facing viewer-left, same as input1. Draw on logical native pixel scale about36px dogheight (Guri density); enlarged nearest-neighbor look. No body morphing or frame-to-frame color/marking drift. Every consecutive drawing must be tiny intermediate step, not unrelated keyposes; keep first and last looping seamlessly.
Action WALK: cheerful continuous12frame trotting cycle. The face is happy, smile with small pink tongue, eyes and muzzle fixed. Legs alternate forward/back with intermediate contact and passing poses; four paws remain clearly separate. Smooth subtle body bob max1 logical pixel. Tail sways left-to-right and returns with small in-between changes, not abrupt flipping or new silhouette every frame. Tail and head maintain size. Frames1-6 first half stride,7-12 opposite half stride, frame12 leads naturally back1. No jumps, landing poses, stretching/squashing, head turns, bowl or ground.
